libraries.name: Document extraction
libraries.what: Pulls dates, parties, governing law, renewal and notice terms, liability caps and minimum commitments out of contracts, and flags ten kinds of clause, each answer with the pattern that gave it.

libraries.what: How every kept pattern was built (which proposer, which recipe, what it cost), looked up first the next night so a sibling task starts from what already worked; and Kar's own build checks, kept on Kar's machine.
